source: Gina Storey, supplied 25 September 2026 (website.zip). Her words; only typos and long dashes corrected. From 'Luxury Travel with Travelling Places.docx'.
title: Luxury Travel with Travelling Places

intro.heading: More than just a holiday
paragraphs: Travelling Places offers extraordinary tailor-made journeys to the world's finest destinations. But real luxury travel is about far more than just five-star hotels; here are some of the ways that we provide a truly luxurious experience on every step of your journey:

ways.title: Your own personal travel specialist
paragraphs: Luxury is having an expert travel consultant who knows the region you're visiting, and can personalise your itinerary into a truly bespoke, tailor-made holiday. Our specialists have all travelled extensively. They have a helpful, informed approach to planning holidays and will offer suggestions based on first hand knowledge and extensive training that Travelling Places invests in.

ways.title: Truly tailor-made travel
paragraphs: While we offer plenty of travel inspiration on our website and in our brochures, that's just the beginning. Whether we're helping you choose that perfect hotel, organising a bespoke sightseeing tour or simply arranging your visas and travel insurance, everything we do is designed to meet your individual needs, making your holiday a truly tailor-made experience.

ways.title: An independent company with high standards
paragraphs: As an independent tour company with long-standing worldwide partners and travel advisors that have worked with us for several years, Travelling Places is able to cater to your every need with a high standard of service unmatched in the industry.

ways.title: Virtuoso membership
paragraphs: Travelling Places is proud to be associated with the invitation only Virtuoso global travel group. Recognised as the top 1% of agencies worldwide, Travelling Places benefits from networking with industry leaders globally and securing exclusive opportunities for our clients to benefit from.

Imagine checking into your hotel and being recognised with complimentary breakfast, a food and beverage credit to use at the hotel and perhaps a room upgrade. Sail on a Virtuoso affiliate cruise line and receive on board credits, an invitation to an exclusive cocktail party or a unique shore excursion. There are lots of benefits for our clients through the Virtuoso affiliation.

ways.title: Complete protection
paragraphs: At Travelling Places we believe in looking after your money, and your peace of mind. That's why we are a fully accredited agent with ATIA, the Australian Travel Industry Association. We also offer comprehensive travel insurance to our clients: ask for details on the options we offer.

ways.title: Full support while travelling
paragraphs: Your travel specialist will be on hand not only before your departure, but also while you are on the road, to step in if plans need changing or you need some unforeseen support.

ways.title: A community of travellers
paragraphs: We offer regular in-house events and exclusive invitations to our clients, building on the community of explorers that inspired our founding and continues to inspire us each and every day.
